description: This file contains language localization definitions for the Summernote WYSIWYG editor in Romanian, specifically for the 'ro-RO' locale. It defines translated strings for UI components such as font styles, image handling, video, link, table, paragraph styles, colors, shortcuts, help, history, and special characters.

methods.name: $.extend
methods.description: A method used to merge the contents of two or more objects into the first object, used here to extend the $.summernote.lang object with Romanian language definitions.
